title: thresholded-shadow-canary-orchestration-with-quarantine
author: Marisol Vega
description: Motivation: production model promotion needs deterministic, metric-driven promotion and a lightweight quarantine path for problematic variants without full rollback noise. This PR implements a thresholded shadow->canary promotion flow and a quarantine first-class primitive that isolates models showing drift or error spikes. Changes include: new rollout controller state machine, metric threshold DSL, quarantine API surface, deterministic warmup windows, and end-to-end integration with the observability stack and canary alerts. Design highlights: 1) Shadow priming stage: route mirrored traffic to candidate model while keeping responses hidden; automatic delta metrics (latency, token-err, perplexity, hallucination-score) computed over sampling windows. 2) Threshold evaluation: a compact DSL in rollout config allows percentage and absolute thresholds with lookback windows (e.g., latency_p95<120ms AND token_err_rate_delta<0.5%). 3) Canary promotion: automated gradual traffic bump with hold windows and automated rollback if thresholds violated. 4) Quarantine: when a threshold breach occurs during shadow or canary, the controller moves the variant to 'quarantined' state, which preserves logs, stops routing live traffic, and spins a lightweight readonly debug endpoint for replaying failing traces. 5) Safety: automatic cooldowns, explicit owner notifications, and a manual override to promote from quarantine after investigation. This description includes the user-visible rollout configuration changes and the operational playbook.

release_notes: Add thresholded shadow-to-canary promotion flow and a quarantine lifecycle for model variants. Operators can now configure metric thresholds to trigger automated rollback and quarantine, inspect quarantined variants via console, and replay traces for debugging. Includes new rollout schema and example configs.
testing_plan: Unit tests cover DSL parsing and state transitions; integration tests exercise mirrored traffic, delta metrics, and quarantine transitions. E2E harness runs realistic traffic patterns to validate canary bumping and automated rollback. Manual QA: run shadow example config against staging, verify quarantined variant is isolated and replay works.
rollout_plan: Ship behind feature flag. Stage 1: enable shadow mirroring for internal customers only (1 week). Stage 2: enable automated threshold evaluation and quarantine alerts in staging. Stage 3: activate automated canary promotion with conservative steps (0.5% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20%) and hold windows. Monitor p95, token_err_rate and hallucination-score deltas; any threshold breach moves candidate to quarantine. Provide manual override path for owners.
performance_impact: Shadow mirroring adds a small async forwarding cost; observed 0.7% overall CPU increase in staging under representative load. Deterministic warmups reduce cold-start variance; no material latency regression for primary path.
